description: Ministry of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation - Appoint the Competent Authority, Institute of Technology University of Moratuwa
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Dr. Bandula Gunawardana) in his official capacity as Minister and also names another individual (Dr. Nawaratnage Sunil Jayantha Nawaratne) who is being appointed. It contains detailed descriptions of responsibilities and powers being assigned to the Competent Authority, including exercising powers "in lieu of the Director" and performing functions under various legal instruments. This combination of named individuals with detailed portfolio responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
